subject: POC kickoff + rotating hands-on windows — proposed schedule & prep
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Chen <lucy.chen@acuityhealth.com>; Mateo Ruiz <mateo.ruiz@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25 09:12 PDT
Subject: POC kickoff + rotating hands-on windows — proposed schedule & prep

Hi Lucy & Mateo —

Great to meet you both last week. We're ready to lock in the POC kickoff and the series of hands-on working sessions (prompt review, routing tests, and at-scale load tests). To keep the working sessions inclusive across Acuity’s US/EU/APAC teams, we recommend a rotating window approach so the same Redwood engineers don’t have to be on every call.

Proposed kickoff (90 min):
- Tue Nov 2 15:00–16:30 UTC (US morning / EU afternoon / APAC evening) — intro + scoping + baseline run

Then three hands-on sessions, each 60 min, rotating times:
- Session A (US-friendly): Thu Nov 4 16:00–17:00 UTC
- Session B (EU-friendly): Mon Nov 8 08:00–09:00 UTC
- Session C (APAC-friendly): Wed Nov 10 22:00–23:00 UTC

Please confirm whether those time blocks would work for your broader team (particularly ops and data engineering). If any of those slots are hard, we can slide ±2 hours.

Prep items from Redwood (attached): agenda, load-test plan, and a timezone matrix. Ask items for Acuity: a short list of sample prompts (3–5) for prompt-review, routing policy examples, and an IP allowlist for our test hosts.

Next steps:
1) Lucy: confirm kickoff slot and preferred attendees by Mon Oct 26 EOD PT
2) Acuity: share sample prompts and routing examples by Oct 28
3) Redwood: we'll publish calendar invites and a short runbook once times are confirmed

Thanks — looking forward to getting this in motion.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: redwood_poc_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF), load-test-plan_v2.xlsx (Excel), timezone_matrix.csv (CSV)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the clear plan. Overall those windows look reasonable. A couple quick notes from our side:
- The proposed kickoff on Nov 2 is OK for the core team, but our Head of Data (EU) asked if it could start 30 minutes earlier (14:30 UTC) — is that possible?
- For Session C (APAC-friendly) the 22:00–23:00 UTC slot is rough for our Ops people in Manila. Can you do 21:00–22:00 UTC instead?

We’ll send the sample prompts and routing policies by Oct 28. Also attaching our initial attendee list (sent to salesops) — we can expand if needed.

Lucy

Hi all —

14:30 UTC works for the kickoff for Redwood (we’ll shift the engineer rota). We can also take Session C to 21:00–22:00 UTC as requested.

A couple logistic asks from the engineering side:
- Can Acuity provide a short list of peak request sizes and a representative request per minute expectation for the load test? We’ll build the load profile in the attached plan.
- Confirm whether you want long-lived KV caching enabled for the load tests (saves cost but changes latency characteristics)

I’ll update the calendar draft once Lucy confirms the final attendee list.

— Karthik

Thanks Karthik —

Confirmed: kickoff moved to Tue Nov 2 14:30–16:00 UTC. Session C shifted to 21:00–22:00 UTC.

Load details (summary):
- Peak concurrency expected: 150 rps
- Typical steady: 25–40 rps
- Representative payloads: 1) short user prompt (<=50 tokens), 2) templated clinical summary (500–700 tokens)
- We prefer KV caching enabled for warm-path tests, but run one cold-path iteration without caching

Attendee list uploaded to salesops. Let us know if we should set up a separate VPC peering ticket/PAL for the load IPs.

— Lucy
